7118.title: PR number color ignores actionable signals
7118.rootCauseOneLine: The thread-row number selects a lifecycle-only green class for open pull requests instead of consulting existing attention and CI signals.
7118.proposedFix: Resolve the thread-row number color from lifecycle, attention, and checks using existing theme tokens while preserving draft and terminal lifecycle colors.
7118.caveats: Repeated by the same agent in two clean trusted checkouts. Screenshots show actual component HTML with synthetic data and app CSS, not the full desktop app; live GitHub polling and macOS hover were not tested.
